Propose now with candidate A.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_NfgS4R9ZritHOODkQD0n2411","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { env } from \"zttp:env\";\nimport { parseBearer, jwtVerify } from \"zttp:auth\";\n\nstructural AuthGuard<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"fault_covered\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): AuthGuard<Response> {\n  const secret = env(\"JWT_SECRET\");\n  if (secret === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"authentication unavailable\" }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n  const authorization = req.headers.get(\"Authorization\");\n  if (authorization === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing bearer token\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  const token = parseBearer(authorization);\n  if (token === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing bearer token\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  if (!jwtVerify(token, secret).ok) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"invalid token\" }, { status: 401 });\n  }\n  return Response.json({ authenticated: true });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":27897,"completion_tokens":634,"total_tokens":28531,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":27648},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":203},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":27648,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":249},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
